control_result.system: V58 state plus frozen V57 compiler

candidate_result.system: V59 event-role state plus the same frozen V57 compiler

deterministic_false_action_gap.cause: Each sentence has an explicit third-party owner and past benefactive morphology such as てくれた, but no retrospective adverb. V59 therefore left event_time unknown, emitted no past-experiential relation, and preserved V58's false local-directive state.

direct_request_role_span_gap.cause: The grounded mention spans stopped at 怒, 悲し, or 驚, leaving 顔 inside the tail inspected by the direct-request matcher. The matcher therefore missed the full expression predicate even though inherited V58 state and V57 compilation still executed the valid command.

benefactive_request_boundary_gap.cause: The request-marker pattern matched bare くれ inside past benefactive くれて, so directive_governor became unknown rather than none. Past-experiential relations still prevented action, but the internal role representation was wrong.

shared_fallback_semantic_residual.reason_not_next_variable: This is one non-action state-label residual. Four deterministic false actions are the higher-priority blocker, so changing model size now would mix variables and would not repair the primary failure.

compositional_negation_residual.input: 大変な状況にも関わらず、彼はいつも笑顔を絶やさない。
compositional_negation_residual.cause: Target-local negation treated 絶やさない as negating 笑顔 rather than asserting the continued presence of a smile. This is a separate compositional-negation problem.

causal_interpretation: V59 produced a large, statistically clear paired improvement and generalized all three intended relations, but it failed the preregistered zero-false-action and role-slot gates. The independent evidence supports the owner-governor-time direction while rejecting this implementation as sufficient or deployable.
next_experiment_order: Preregister one V60 event-aspect and predicate-boundary variable on non-holdout development examples: infer past from completed benefactive morphology without requiring a temporal adverb, distinguish benefactive くれて or くれた from imperative くれ, and derive direct requests from the complete grounded predicate rather than a truncated mention tail.
Implement V60 without case IDs, exact holdout strings, answer tables, model-size changes, compiler changes, memory, or identity prompts.
Replay the consumed V59 holdout only as development evidence, then construct a second fresh independent holdout before any advancement claim.

Keep compositional negation and the single shared-fallback label error as separate residual experiments. Compare free local model sizes only after deterministic event-role and compiler errors are removed.
evidence_boundary: This failed independent holdout authorizes only a new preregistered representation experiment. It does not authorize post-run threshold changes, case removal, runtime integration, shadow deployment, physical VRM execution, complete-right-brain claims, or broad human-likeness claims.
